name: DS18S20 1-Wire digital thermometer
description: Maxim/Analog Devices high-precision 1-Wire digital thermometer, -55 to +125 °C (±0.5 °C from -10 to +85 °C, ±2 °C over the full range), fixed 9-bit reading (0.5 °C per LSB) plus COUNT_REMAIN / COUNT_PER_C bytes for extended resolution (1/16 °C steps), 750 ms conversion, unique 64-bit ROM code with family code 10h. Runs on 3.0-5.5 V. Sold as: DS18S20+ in a 3-pin TO-92 through-hole package (datasheet bottom view; with the flat face towards you and legs down: GND, DQ, VDD), needing an external 4.7 kΩ pull-up from DQ to VDD.
eli5: A small thermometer chip that sends the temperature as a number down a single wire; several can share the same wire.

pins.name: GND
pins.description: Ground (TO-92 pin 1, left with the flat face towards you)

pins.name: DQ
pins.description: 1-Wire data in/out, open-drain (TO-92 pin 2, middle); needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to VDD

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply, 3.0-5.5 V (TO-92 pin 3, right). Use 3.3 V with an ESP32 or Pico so the pull-up keeps DQ at 3.3 V logic

buildNotes: Pin order with the flat face towards you, legs down: left = GND, middle = DQ, right = VDD (the datasheet drawing is a bottom view). Wired backwards it gets hot fast: unplug it at once.
Fit a 4.7 kΩ pull-up from DQ to VDD and power VDD from 3.3 V when DQ goes to an ESP32 or Pico.
Send Convert T (44h), then wait at least 750 ms before Read Scratchpad (BEh); MicroPython's ds18x20 module does the commands and the CRC check (it recognises family 10h), your code does the wait.

The temperature register is 0.5 °C per LSB (0032h = +25.0 °C, FFCEh = -25.0 °C). ds18x20 adds the datasheet's extended-resolution formula: T = TEMP_READ - 0.25 + (COUNT_PER_C - COUNT_REMAIN) / COUNT_PER_C, COUNT_PER_C = 16, giving 1/16 °C steps.
A reading of exactly 85 °C (00AAh) is the power-on value: the conversion did not finish or the sensor lost power.
The DS18S20 is not the DS18B20: it has no resolution setting (always 750 ms) and a different register format. Code that decodes the scratchpad by hand must check the family code (10h vs 28h).
Use VDD (external power), not parasite power: parasite mode needs VDD grounded and a strong pull-up during every conversion.

example.code:
import machine, onewire, ds18x20, time

ds = ds18x20.DS18X20(onewire.OneWire(machine.Pin({DQ})))
roms = ds.scan()
print('found', len(roms))
while True:
    ds.convert_temp()
    time.sleep_ms(750)  # conversion takes up to 750 ms
    print('T=%.2fC' % ds.read_temp(roms[0]))
    time.sleep(1)
